name: PIXEL QUEST
author: Matthew
tagline: Run, jump and collect gems in a pixel-art grassland
description: A retro side-scrolling platformer built with Kenney's CC0 Pixel Platformer art. Guide your hero across a stepped grassland, dodge rock spikes and patrolling bots, bonk a lucky block, grab coins, gems and hearts, and reach the flag before your lives run out.
